title: Cleanout.
officialText:
Masonry chimney flues shall be provided with a cleanout opening having a minimum height of 6 inches (152
mm). The upper edge of the opening shall be located not less than 6 inches (152 mm) below the lowest chimney inlet opening. The
cleanout shall be provided with a tight-fitting, noncombustible cover of a minimum size of 8 inches by 8 inches (203 mm by 203
mm).
